text_simplified: This text aims to clarify that tarbiyah (Islamic upbringing) in Islam is built upon sound knowledge derived from the Qur'an and the Prophetic Sunnah. It emphasizes that reciting the Qur'an and applying it in life aids in tazkiyah (purification of the self) and constructing a balanced Muslim personality. It also points out that the natural and social environment influences human behavior, and that the goal is to achieve righteousness in this world and the Hereafter.

review_defects.why: The Arabic phrase means 'sound cognitive foundations' or 'correct knowledge bases', but the English reduces it to 'sound knowledge', omitting the concept of foundations (أسس) and the adjective 'معرفية' (cognitive/knowledge-related).
